_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/: build.py, walk_grid.py, fetch_walk.py, fetch_drive.py, page.html). Everything a fact sheet says that is Toronto's own: the places (neighbourhoods), the hubs, the drive destinations, the agencies and the page's wording. factsheet.css styles the route badges and line bullets in the TTC's colours.

labels.walkBike: Commute on foot or by bike (2021)
labels.railRoutes: GO buses and trains stopping here

page.description: Printable one-page fact sheets for each of Toronto’s 158 neighbourhoods: subway, buses and streetcars, highways, drive times, parking, EV charging, parks and libraries. Drop a pin for walk and drive times from any spot.
page.pinned: Pinned spot (rounded to about 100 m) in the City’s {name} neighbourhood
page.outside: That spot is outside the City of Toronto. Try a spot inside the city.
page.noMatch: No match in Toronto for “{q}”. Try the full street name, like “789 Yonge Street”.
page.placeholder: Search an address, like 789 Yonge Street
page.credits: Boundaries: City of Toronto Open Data · Transit: TTC · Bike Share: Toronto Parking Authority · Census figures: 2021
